# .github/workflows/test-proxy.yml
name: Test Profile Proxy
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
      - name: Run test
        env:
          PLAYHQ_PROXY_SECRET: ${{ secrets.PLAYHQ_PROXY_SECRET }}
        run: |
          node --input-type=module << 'NODEOF'
          import crypto from 'crypto';
          const PROXY_URL    = 'https://playhq-profile-proxy.insanoflash.workers.dev';
          const PROXY_SECRET = process.env.PLAYHQ_PROXY_SECRET;
          const HEADERS = {'accept':'*/*','origin':'https://www.playhq.com','user-agent':'PlayHQ/1.47.2 Android/28 (Android SDK built for x86)','tenant':'basketball-victoria','content-type':'application/json'};
          const API_URL = 'https://api.playhq.com/graphql';
          const Q = `query ProfileSeasonStatistics($profileID: ID!) { publicProfileStatistics(profileID: $profileID) { seasonStatistics { statistics { season { id } } } } }`;

          // 10 known-PRESENT UUIDs — confirmed multiple times throughout this session
          const FIRST_10 = [
            '00aad449-07ad-43c2-ba28-e03f112d1d87',
            '0026fcee-f2b4-464a-821b-d78b55ff1022',
            'd5fdad36-60a7-422c-b219-93aaeb438e3c',
            '004d6d92-6c89-4066-9456-6eee0126088d',
            '0042d002-2c28-4421-b56b-40bef6f7042a',
            '00672d6f-833d-41b7-a065-6e39329bc555',
            '00ffd8c9-77bd-4d96-934d-98dbeabb4df9',
            '00c416f6-3bb4-4587-b9f5-9295fe531dbb',
            '00278e1c-9622-43d8-822a-964f68d1a7d6',
            '009c78f7-73d4-41d0-ae52-5786e9fbdc88',
          ];
          // UUID 11 — always 403s in fetch script, PRESENT when called first
          const UUID_11 = '001b7383-8d8f-4cdd-97da-6cdb3f9a5222';

          const authRes = await fetch(API_URL, {method:'POST',headers:{...HEADERS,'request-id':crypto.randomUUID()},body:JSON.stringify({operationName:'ProfileSearch',variables:{fullName:'a'},query:'query ProfileSearch($fullName: String!) { profileSearch(fullName: $fullName) { result { id } } }'})});
          const raw = authRes.headers.get('set-cookie');
          const cookie = raw.split(',').map(c=>c.trim().split(';')[0]).join('; ');
          console.log(`Cookie: ${cookie.split(';').map(p=>p.trim().split('=')[0]).join(', ')}\n`);

          async function call(uuid, n) {
            const t = Date.now();
            const res = await fetch(PROXY_URL, {method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json','X-Proxy-Secret':PROXY_SECRET},body:JSON.stringify({cookie,graphql:{operationName:'ProfileSeasonStatistics',variables:{profileID:uuid},query:Q}})});
            const ms = Date.now()-t;
            let r; if(res.status===403){r='403';} else {try{const j=await res.json();r=j.errors?'NOT_FOUND':j?.data?.publicProfileStatistics?`PRESENT(${j.data.publicProfileStatistics.seasonStatistics?.length}s)`:'NULL';}catch{r='ERR';}}
            const icon = r.startsWith('PRESENT')?'✓':r==='403'?'✗':'○';
            console.log(`  ${icon} #${String(n).padStart(2)} [${uuid.slice(0,8)}] ${r} — HTTP ${res.status} — ${ms}ms`);
            return r;
          }

          console.log('── Requests 1-10 (10 known-PRESENT UUIDs, sequential) ──');
          for (let i = 0; i < FIRST_10.length; i++) {
            await call(FIRST_10[i], i + 1);
          }

          console.log('\n── Request 11 (001b7383 — always 403s in fetch script) ──');
          const result = await call(UUID_11, 11);

          if (result === '403') {
            console.log('\n→ REPRODUCED — 403 after 10 prior PRESENT requests');
            console.log('→ The WAF limit is exactly 10 successful lookups per session/window');
          } else {
            console.log(`\n→ NOT reproduced — returned ${result} after 10 prior requests`);
            console.log('→ Something specific to the fetch script environment causes the 403');
          }
          NODEOF
